sample_unit: five public 3D medical image collections (number of images not reported)

links.outcome: Ability of automated failure detection methods to flag segmentation failures under test-time distribution shift
links.effect: Pairwise Dice score between ensemble predictions performed best as a simple, robust failure detection baseline; pixel confidence aggregation was important. No numeric results reported in the abstract.
links.quote: Our findings highlight the importance of pixel confidence aggregation and we observe superior performance of the pairwise Dice score (Roy et al., 2019) between ensemble predictions, positioning it as a simple and robust baseline for failure detection in medical image segmentation.

unlisted_practices: Using risk-coverage analysis as the evaluation approach for failure detection methods
Choosing pixel confidence aggregation strategies for segmentation failure detection

screen.practice: failure detection via confidence aggregation for segmentation outputs
screen.reason: Evaluates failure detection and confidence aggregation safeguards for medical image segmentation models under test-time distribution shifts.

primary.practice: failure detection and confidence aggregation under distribution shift
